purpose: Joint native varying-frequency fits of F3 acoustic ridge candidates; separate training-fit success from conditional held-window parameter prediction
parent: accel_ridges_v1/observe2: all original reference peaks, unique moving associations and unchanged guide/support flags; do not use its moving/fixed classification to discard candidates
initial_frequency: Selected original current-window native FFT bin, at most one per reference candidate; absent/ambiguous remain unfit. No new window/range/seed search
initial_chirp: Centered difference of adjacent unique observed ridge frequencies, or one-sided difference at boundaries; zero if neither adjacent observation exists. The native solver may refine independent per-line chirps
phase_basis: cos/sin(2pi*(f*t+0.5*q*t*t)), native periodic-Hann square-root weighted real least squares; same independent f/q in both channels, independent amplitudes/phases, no shared engine phase
fit: Reuse existing line_motion waveform/Jacobian, bounded frequency/q nonlinear fit in left channel; right coefficients are joint linear LS using its fitted basis. Preserve all bounds/optimizer failures and both-channel support
train_tiles: First half of each passage, by fixed tile index
check_tiles: Second half; already inspected source windows, NOT a pristine or independent holdout. No fitted coefficient from them may enter the training summary
prediction: Per-reference median training f/guideRatio and RMS amplitude. Given unchanged check-window acoustic ratio, predict center frequency and constant amplitude, and compare to independently locally fitted check coefficients. No fitted phase or check amplitude used in prediction, no waveform-replay claim
eligibility: At least3eligible training and3eligible check fits; report per-line errors and all missing lines. Engineering diagnostic targets frequency<=one4Hzbin and median absolute amplitude<=3dB; not source identity or timbre gates
known_controls: 26dense independently phased moving harmonics plus4fixed modes
synthesis_policy: Only if native parameter evidence is adequate consider a separately declared audible source recipe. Do not export common-phase DNA, fill omitted LF by random bass, change accepted moving35/F2 or runtime merely because local residuals are low
source_and_state_limits: F3 cabin only, no exact RPM/load/AV calibration or independent takes. Existing phase-extractor qualification is neither replaced nor waived
